fields.Name: Sales: Won Deal Payments
fields.UserQuestion: Which invoices on my won deals are paid, partly paid, outstanding or not invoiced yet?
fields.Description: One row per invoice on a won deal's order, with what was invoiced, what has been paid, what is still owed and when it is due. The drill-through behind the payment columns on the deals list.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: invoice -- one row per OrderHeaderPaymentSchedule instalment when the deal's order has a schedule, otherwise one row for the order header (billed as a single invoice). Reads __mj_BizAppsSales.vwWonDealInvoices, whose rows the Deals view's payment columns sum, so the two agree. Won is DealStatusType.IsWon. Canceled and WrittenOff instalments and Voided orders are excluded. IsInvoiced: an instalment whose Status is Invoiced or Paid, or a Confirmed order with no schedule. PaymentStatus (from fnDealPaymentStatus): Not invoiced, Partly paid (AmountPaid > 0 and Balance > 0), Outstanding (Balance > 0, nothing paid) or Paid (Balance <= 0). No overdue status until due dates are reliable (bc-aidp-next-golive#481). Amount, AmountPaid and Balance are orders' stored figures. Date dimension: DueDate (the instalment's, or the order's). FILTERS: CompanyIDs, OwnerEmployeeIDs, PipelineIDs and ProductCompanyIDs are arrays rendered with sqlIn, applied as in Sales: Deal Roster; single-value CompanyID, PipelineID and OwnerEmployeeID also work.
